description: The upload endpoint accepts files and returns their path. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. In one eval, POST to /api/upload with fetch a multipart form (FormData) whose field "file" is a file named "test.txt" of type text/plain containing "test file content", read the response's JSON, and return JSON.stringify({status: response.status, path: typeof json.path, uploads: json.path.includes("/tmp/shelley-uploads/"), txt: json.path.includes(".txt")}).
